You are welcome! I am a second-year PhD student in the [Department of Statistical Science](https://statistics.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/) at [Baylor University, Waco, Texas](https://www.baylor.edu/). I earned my master's in Ms Mathematics-Statistics at South Dakota State
University where I had the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Linear Algebra, ML(Clustering and Classification Algorithms) and Probability Measure.

Linear Algebra which serves as the foundation for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence(AI). Studying Linear Algebra at the Master's level. With that, I believe I am well-prepared to take on challenging projects in Statistics, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.


PhD Statistical Science at Baylor, is where I continue to learn statistical methods for Bayesian Inference , Survival Analysis, building predictive models.  


Outside the classroom, I do spend time speaking to my family and taking nature photographs along the Brazos river.

Learn about my professional and academic journey here on this page!
